scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:migrate:last:local: bash -lc 'LATEST=$(ls -1t migrations/*.sql | head -n 1) && echo Applying $LATEST && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file "$LATEST"'
scripts.db:migrate:last:remote: bash -lc 'LATEST=$(ls -1t migrations/*.sql | head -n 1) && echo Applying $LATEST && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file "$LATEST"'
